description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) file used in OpenEmbedded/Yocto recipes for building U-Boot tools such as mkimage and mkenvimage. It specifies dependencies, packaging, build instructions, and installation steps related to U-Boot bootloader utilities.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Builds U-Boot tools by setting up the environment, configuring, and compiling the make targets.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs U-Boot tools binaries into the designated directory and creates necessary symbolic links.
